help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about flights, bookings, and payments.
help.faq_search_q: How do I search for flights?
help.faq_search_a: On the home page, select origin, destination, dates, and number of passengers. Click 'Search Flights' and see the best options available in real time.
help.faq_booking_steps_q: What are the steps to make a booking?
help.faq_booking_steps_a: 1) Find and choose the perfect flight for you. 2) Fill in the passenger details. 3) Pay securely using your credit card. 4) Receive confirmation and your booking reference code.
help.faq_multi_city_q: Can I book flights for multiple destinations?
help.faq_multi_city_a: Absolutely! Use the 'Multi-City' search and add up to 5 legs in a single booking.
help.faq_passengers_q: How many passengers can I include in a booking?
help.faq_passengers_a: You can book for up to 9 passengers, including adults, children, and infants comfortably.
help.faq_payment_methods_q: What are the accepted payment methods?
help.faq_payment_methods_a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) with secure payment via Stripe.
help.faq_payment_secure_a: Definitely! We use Stripe, a global leader in online payments, with advanced encryption and PCI DSS compliance.
help.faq_currency_q: In which currency are prices displayed?
help.faq_currency_a: Prices are shown in US Dollars (USD). The final amount may vary depending on your bank's exchange rate.
help.faq_manage_booking_q: How do I track my booking?
help.faq_manage_booking_a: Access 'My Trips' to view all your bookings. You can also search by the reference code (MT-XXXXXX) along with your email.
help.faq_cancel_a: Yes! Request cancellation in 'My Trips'. Refunds follow the airline's rules and will be informed before confirmation.
help.faq_baggage_q: How do I add extra baggage?
help.faq_baggage_a: At the time of booking, select extra baggage options for each passenger with prices determined by the airlines.
help.faq_reference_q: Where do I find my reference code?
help.faq_reference_a: Your code (MT-XXXXXX) is available on the confirmation page and in the email we sent. Use it to check your booking at any time.
help.faq_create_account_a: Click 'Sign In' in the top right corner, choose Email or GitHub, and follow the steps to create your registration quickly.
help.faq_edit_profile_a: After logging in, access 'My Profile' to update your information and personal preferences conveniently.
help.faq_contact_a: Talk to us via internal messages, chat with our virtual assistant Mia, email, or phone. We are ready to help!
help.faq_response_time_q: What is the support response time?
help.faq_response_time_a: We respond within 24 hours. For urgent cases, use the chat with Mia, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
help.faq_live_help_q: Can I talk to a live agent?
help.faq_live_help_a: Of course! Request live support via chat with Mia and a specialist will be ready to help you in real time.
